item.title: Liège Travel Guide & History | 374 Steps and a Rebellious Soul
item.description:
Liège, in Belgium, has a staircase of 374 stone steps, the Montagne de Bueren, built so soldiers in the hilltop citadel could flood down into the city in minutes.
